result.topic_en: Notes on the transformations of Riemann's P-function (hypergeometric integral) that carry one integral into seven others, on the convergence regions of the series in x and x/(x-1), and on series expansions of the Euler-type integral $\Gamma(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)=\int_0^1 y^\alpha(1-y)^\beta(1-xy)^\gamma dy$ at x and 1-x.
